description: Canonical 14-feature schema for SentinelAI Phishing & Scam Link Shield. Shared identically across Python training and JavaScript inference.

features.name: url_length
features.description: Total character length of the full URL (lowercased, trimmed).

features.name: domain_length
features.description: Character length of the hostname/domain component.

features.name: num_dots
features.description: Count of dot '.' characters within the hostname.

features.name: has_ip
features.description: 1 if hostname is a raw IPv4 or IPv6 address, 0 otherwise.

features.name: has_at_symbol
features.description: 1 if '@' character appears anywhere in the full URL (credential masking), 0 otherwise.

features.name: num_hyphens
features.description: Count of '-' characters within the hostname (typosquatting indicator).

features.name: num_subdomains
features.description: Depth of subdomains beyond the root domain (0 for raw IP or domain.tld).

features.name: is_https
features.description: 1 if URL protocol scheme is HTTPS, 0 for HTTP or other schemes.

features.name: has_double_slash_in_path
features.description: 1 if '//' appears anywhere in the URL pathname (open-redirect / evasion indicator), 0 otherwise.

features.name: num_suspicious_keywords
features.description: Count of matched sensitive authentication, banking, or account keywords in path and query.

features.name: has_suspicious_tld
features.description: 1 if the top-level domain belongs to the documented high-abuse TLD list, 0 otherwise.

features.name: num_query_params
features.description: Count of URL query parameter key-value pairs.

features.name: special_char_count
features.description: Count of special characters (%&=?_~) in the full URL.

features.name: domain_entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of the hostname character distribution rounded to 3 decimal places.
